Now, you might wonder why we'd do that, right? It's like we're saying, "Give us forgiveness, but also make sure we win the lottery, get the best grades, and have the coolest toys." But here's the important part: this ritual teaches us something valuable. It reminds us that even though we might want things to go our way all the time, life doesn't always work like that.

This ritual is a way for us to express our deepest desires, acknowledge our flaws, and learn to accept what life gives us. It's a reminder that sometimes we need to ask for forgiveness and work hard to create our own good fortune, instead of just demanding it. And that, my friend, is a crucial life lesson!
